transactions.description: This asset was held in the Lane M. Sherman Trust. Filer is one of many beneficiaries of that Trust. Under the terms of the trust, the filer is to receive approximately 1/5th of the total assets held by the trust on 1/1/22. This bond was transferred in full to another beneficiary outright on November 28.
